desc: Prove that minimizing grinding cost is equivalent to maximizing the common paired sum \(H\).
Derive the valid interval for each final upper tooth for a fixed candidate \(H\), including nonnegativity constraints.
Design and verify the linear-time greedy feasibility check for intervals with \(|u_i-u_{i+1}| \le X\).
Establish binary-search bounds for \(H\) and confirm monotonicity of feasibility.
Implement the algorithm in Python using 64-bit-safe integer arithmetic, stdin/stdout handling, and verify it against samples.
